name: Tiingo
tagline: Enterprise-grade market data API for equities, crypto, news, and fundamentals
description: Tiingo is a financial markets data platform offering REST and WebSocket APIs for end-of-day (EOD) stock prices, IEX real-time/intraday data, overnight BOATS prices, cryptocurrency prices across many exchanges, U.S. fundamentals, and institutional financial news. Developers authenticate with a free self-serve API token. A free Starter tier supports light usage; paid Power and commercial plans unlock higher limits and broader product access.

auth.details: API token from free self-serve signup; pass as Authorization: Token YOUR_API_KEY header (also supports ?token= query param). Token shown under Account → API.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Starter ($0): 500 unique symbols/month, 50 requests/hour, 1,000 requests/day, 1 GB bandwidth/month; includes EOD, crypto, IEX, limited news
pricing.paid_plans: Power $30/mo ($300/yr) individual: ~109k symbols/mo, 10k req/hr, 100k req/day, 40 GB/mo; commercial ~$50/mo ($499/yr); higher Start-up/Enterprise plans available

rate_limits: Free Starter: 50 requests/hour, 1,000 requests/day; Power: 10,000 requests/hour, 100,000 requests/day (per pricing page)
use_cases: fetch end-of-day OHLCV history for a US stock or ETF
get latest EOD price for one or more tickers
pull consolidated crypto prices across exchanges
stream or poll IEX real-time equity quotes
search financial news articles for a ticker or topic
retrieve U.S. fundamental indicators for equities
